structural_diagnosis.explanation: Cross-section σ_cs is non-negative by construction. Its rolling-30d distribution is right-skewed (variance/std distributions have hard zero lower bound + unbounded upper tail). Applying symmetric z-score → z ≤ -2 is statistically impossible in 2.36yr of data. Hypothesis trigger form (z<-2) is structurally incompatible with statistic shape.
fix_options_for_future_paradigms: Use percentile rank instead of z (e.g., σ_cs ≤ p10 rolling-30d quantile)
Log-transform σ_cs before z-score (log σ_cs distribution is more symmetric)
Define compression by absolute σ_cs threshold (e.g., σ_cs ≤ 0.002)

lesson_candidates.title: Non-negative aggregate statistics (std/var/magnitude) admit only one-sided z-score thresholds
lesson_candidates.summary: When the statistic S is structurally non-negative (S = std, var, count, magnitude, dispersion), its rolling-window distribution is right-skewed with a hard zero lower bound. A symmetric z-score threshold (z ≤ -2 vs z ≥ +2) is asymmetric in achievability: the upper tail can have rare events, but the lower tail is bounded by ~(-mean/std) of the rolling window. For typical 30d windows on noisy returns, z_S min is ≈ -1.5 to -2.0 best case, often -1.2 to -1.8. R-0 prescreen MUST measure empirical z-distribution range BEFORE trigger threshold definition.
lesson_candidates.prescreen_addition: Add to R-0: if hypothesis uses z-threshold on a non-negative statistic, compute empirical z.min() over 1y sample. If z.min() > threshold, HALT_BY_STRUCTURE.

verdict_reason_refined: Lesson #11 + #23 fail downstream of structural infeasibility. z_disp ≤ -2.0 is impossible-by-construction in 2.36yr panel (observed z_disp.min() = -1.92). Cross-section std is non-negative → rolling z-score lower tail bounded by (-rolling_mean / rolling_std) ≈ -1.92 in this panel. Symmetric z-threshold (matching paradigm 69 highvol z>p90 form) is geometrically inverted: σ-shape statistics admit only upper-tail z thresholds, not lower.

hypothesis_rescue_paths.name: percentile_rank_compression
hypothesis_rescue_paths.description: Trigger: σ_cs ≤ rolling_30d_quantile(0.05 or 0.10). Achievable always; tests bottom-decile dispersion regime.

hypothesis_rescue_paths.name: log_transform_then_zscore
hypothesis_rescue_paths.description: Compute z on log(σ_cs) → log-transform makes distribution closer to symmetric Gaussian. z ≤ -2 then achievable.

hypothesis_rescue_paths.name: ratio_compression
hypothesis_rescue_paths.description: Trigger: σ_cs(t) / rolling_30d_mean(σ_cs) ≤ 0.5 (half of typical dispersion).
